page_title: WER 1-1 RBL | Werder Bremen v RB Leipzig 19/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Michael Zetterer, who makes a comfortable save.
90+1' Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+1' This is a yellow card! Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
87' It will be a substitution. Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) is ready to enter the pitch as Justin Njinmah walks off.
85' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
84' Marco Rose prepares a substitution. Xavi Simons is replaced by Fabio Carvalho (RB Leipzig).
84' Tobias Reichel shows a yellow card to Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) for his blatant foul.
83' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Leonardo Bittencourt and he is replaced by Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) comes onto the pitch so that Felix Agu can be given a rest.
82' Today's match ends for Christian Gross who will be replaced by Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen).

79' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yussuf Poulsen trots off the pitch and is replaced by Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig).
76' Here is a change. Kevin Kampl is going off and Marco Rose gives the last tactical orders to Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig).
75' 1 - 1 Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
73' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the free kick and curls the ball just over the crossbar. That was close!
69' The game has begun to heat up. Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
66' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Reichel had an easy-decision to make.
63' Marco Rose decides to make a substitution. Emil Forsberg will be replaced by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
62' It's time for a substitution. Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) comes on in place of Rafael Borre.
59' Christian Gross (Werder Bremen) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Reichel and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
55' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
53' Werder Bremen hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
50' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
49' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from RB Leipzig comes to nothing.
47' 0 - 1 Goal! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
46' Marco Rose makes a switch. Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) is coming on in place of Castello Lukeba at the start of the second period.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for RB Leipzig due to an offside in the build-up play.
42' The RB Leipzig players halt their celebrations as referee Tobias Reichel makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
41' An unlucky rebound falls to Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) and he scores with a bullet header.
39' Close! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.

35' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) wastes a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball a few inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
34' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Werder Bremen.

33' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
33' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
32' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance.
31' Half-chance! Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) plays a pass into the box, but Michael Zetterer reacts well to snuff out the attack.
30' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
28' Looks like Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
25' Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

23' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Michael Zetterer makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.
20' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal.
19' Christian Gross (Werder Bremen) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
16' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
12' The ball is cleared after Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
11' The RB Leipzig players are exchanging some short passes.
8' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
8' Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul after Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) hacks down one of his opponents.
7' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
6' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. RB Leipzig earn a corner.
4' Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Tobias Reichel blows his whistle for a foul.
1' OFF THE POST! Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! RB Leipzig will take the kick-off.
Tobias Reichel will referee today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
